_response.answer: The minimum attendance required to appear for end-semester exams is 75% of the total number of classes, including lectures, tutorials, and practicals, held in a subject. This is stated in the NSUT Regulations for Bachelor of Technology, §11.2. [S1] Future notice: Synthetic demo attendance notice A — not university-issued takes effect on 2026-11-01; it is not applied to this answer.
